steps.content: Prima has decided you're a voyager from the foreign world and is very curious about your origins. You offer little explanation, letting her flesh out your character within this scripted experience.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Wow... the foreign world truly is so different from our town. You must have experienced so many thrilling adventures. That's why you seem so composed, right? Amazing! I need to write all this down in my notebook.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you make a habit of writing things down?

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Mm-hmm! I live alone with only books for company. My life is quite ordinary, so... I love hearing other people's stories and—

Before she can finish speaking, darkness suddenly thickens as fog devours all light like a creature's maw. From the distance come piercing howls and the crunching sound of bones being gnawed. Countless eerie green lights flicker among the trees.
You feel the girl beside you tense up, her breathing becoming rapid.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Don't look back! Run, run now! If they catch us, we're done for!
